title: Quiero, puedo, prefiero
summary: Stem-changing verbs quiero/puedo/prefiero (e>ie, o>ue) for ordering and plans

blocks.title: e → ie: querer
blocks.body: Some verbs change their stem vowel in every form except **nosotros** and **vosotros** — like a boot shape. **querer** ('to want') changes **e → ie**: *quiero, quieres, quiere... queremos, queréis... quieren*.
blocks.callout: *preferir* ('to prefer') follows the exact same e→ie pattern: *prefiero, prefieres, prefiere... preferimos, preferís... prefieren*.

blocks.title: o → ue: poder
blocks.body: **poder** ('to be able to, can') changes **o → ue** in the same boot shape — everyone except *nosotros* and *vosotros*.
blocks.callout: *nosotros* and *vosotros* never stem-change — say *queremos, podemos, preferimos* with the plain vowel, no exceptions.

blocks.title: The boot: who changes, who doesn't

pairs.note: The stem change skips *nosotros* and *vosotros* every time.

blocks.prompt: Which form is correct for 'nosotros' with poder ('we can')?
Type: 'I want a small beer.' (using querer)
blocks.explain: *Quiero una caña.* — first-person singular of *querer* stem-changes to *quiero*.
